email.subject: Your feedback matters! Help us serve you better.

thank_you.default: Thanks for your valuable feedback on your experience with us. We sincerely appreciate your insight because it helps us build a better customer experience.
thank_you.promoters: Thank you for your feedback. We are happy to hear that you had a great experience with us. Your feedback helps us discover new opportunities to improve ourselves and make sure you have the best experience.
thank_you.passives: Thank you for your feedback. We want to give you the best possible experience. Your inputs and suggestions play a major role in helping us improve.
thank_you.detractors: Thank you for your feedback. We value all your inputs and suggestions. In the future, our team might reach out to you to learn more about how we can further improve your experience so that it exceeds your expectations.

default.subject: Thanks for your feedback. It means a lot to us.
default.body:
Dear {contact.firstName},

  Thanks for your valuable feedback on your experience with us. We sincerely appreciate your insight because it helps us build a better customer experience.

  If you have any more questions, comments, or concerns or compliments, please feel welcome to reach out to us. We would be more than happy to assist.

  Best,

  {user.name}

promoters.subject: Thanks for your feedback. It means a lot to us.
promoters.body:
Dear {contact.firstName},

  We are delighted to know that you would recommend us to your friends! Your insight helps us improve and build a better customer experience.

  If you have any more questions, comments, or concerns or compliments, please feel welcome to reach out to us. We would be more than happy to assist.

  Best,

  {user.name}

detractors.subject: Thanks for your feedback. It means a lot to us.
detractors.body:
Dear {contact.firstName},

  Thanks for your valuable feedback on your experience with us. We sincerely appreciate your insight because it helps us build a better customer experience.

  We’re sorry you didn’t have the best experience with us. Please reach out to us to know how we can serve you better. We would be more than happy to assist. 

  Best,

  {user.name}
